scripts.dev:api: uv run uvicorn affine.api.server:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --reload-dir packages --port 9000
scripts.build:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -m compileall src
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/web && bun run typecheck && cd ../api && uv run pyrefly check
scripts.lint: cd apps/web && bun run lint && cd ../api && uv run ruff check
scripts.format: cd apps/web && bun run format && cd ../api && uv run ruff format
scripts.test: cd apps/web && bun run test && cd ../api && uv run pytest
